entities.name: Nitro diazabicyclic substrate
observations: Decoded SELFIES gives O=[N+]([O-])CC12CCCN1CCC2, a nitroethyl-substituted diazabicyclic amine.
The nitro group is the apparent reducible functional group under iron/chloride in ethanol.

entities.name: Fe/Cl ethanol reduction
observations: Iron with chloride in ethanol is plausibly an iron-mediated nitro-group reduction system.
Expected transformation is nitro group reduction to a primary amine, with the carbon skeleton retained.

entities.name: Amino diazabicyclic product
observations: Plausible product from nitro reduction is H2NCC12CCCN1CCC2, equivalently NCC12CCCN1CCC2 with the terminal carbon bearing NH2.
This is the corresponding primary amine formed by replacing the nitro group with an amino group.
